The latest test build of Dummio. It updates every time a change lands, so download it again to get new fixes.

## Install in Chrome, Edge or Brave

1. Download **dummio-chrome.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` (in Edge: `edge://extensions`).
3. Turn on **Developer mode**.
4. Click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.

Pin it from the puzzle icon in the toolbar, then open any form and click **Fill page**.

## Install in Firefox (until browser restart)

1. Download **dummio-firefox.zip** below.
2. Open `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`.
3. Click **Load Temporary Add-on** and pick the zip.

## Updating

Download the new zip, replace the old folder, then click the reload icon on Dummio in `chrome://extensions`.

## Tips

- If Alt+Shift+F does nothing, set it at `chrome://extensions/shortcuts`.
- Found a problem? Report it at https://github.com/melvinbulan17/form-filler/issues
